title: Austin City Property & Board Staffing
summary:
*   The council held a closed executive session to discuss significant issues including land acquisition, potential litigation, and city personnel matters.
*   Public discussion included proposals for real estate acquisition and negotiations for a city property lease consolidation project.
*   Extensive appointments were made to over 20 city boards and commissions, staffing critical volunteer roles in ethics, economic development, environmental protection, traffic safety, and community services.
